verdict.summary: This is a baby swing with mosquito net (model BB501) categorized as an infant swing/glider. The verdict is Don't buy because inclined infant sleepers with an incline over 10 degrees have been banned since November 2022 under the Safe Sleep for Babies Act, making it illegal to sell. Additionally, this specific model has been recalled by Vevor for a suffocation hazard.
verdict.seller_message: Hi, thanks for the listing. Just so you know, infant swings with an incline over 10° have been banned since Nov 2022 (Safe Sleep for Babies Act, 16 CFR 1310), and this Vevor model (BB501) was also recalled for a suffocation risk (CPSC recall #26074). verdict.safer_alternative: Consider a flat, firm sleep surface like a crib, bassinet, or play yard that meets current CPSC safety standards.
